integrity: Full symbolic proof of the homotopy and integral symmetry classification, with a self-contained finite consistency checker; no proof is inferred from finite enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary geodesic general-position sets of finite connected complete multipartite graphs only; the face and enumerator description is prior published work. Wedge decomposition is nonequivariant, while the stated integral homology modules are natural. External expert validation and exhaustive novelty review are not performed.
title: Integral homotopy and permutation lattices of multipartite general-position complexes
